title: tc-model-wheel
description: AI model names on a turning drum.

models.description: Models on the wheel – brand marks as a single SVG path; at least 7 keep the drum full

hold.description: Milliseconds a model stays selected before the wheel turns on

turns.description: How many automatic turns before the wheel rests (default: once round the drum; Infinity keeps it turning)

label.description: Describes the scene to assistive tech (role="img"); without it the illustration is decorative and hidden from them
